newsitem.title: USA: Biofield seeks approval for new device.
newsitem.headline: Biofield seeks approval for new device.

text.p: Biofield Corp said Monday it submitted an application for pre-market approval to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for a new breast cancer diagnostic device.
The company said in a release that results from a study on the Biofield ALEXA 1000 System demonstrated accuracy of about 95 percent in identifying malignant breast lesions.
As a result of the favorable findings, Biofield said it has been granted expedited review by the FDA.
Biofield said the study, based on more than 1,000 women scheduled for open surgical biopsy, was conducted at six major medical institutions in the United States.
